source_title: What Should I Do If I Can T Complete The Payment
snippet_primary: "Likewise in places like Argentina, there's a monthly limit for transactions in dollars. If you reach this limit and attempt to complete a new purchase, the payment will be rejected."
subject_exact: Domestika help center (article 360003447297, undated) states Argentina has a monthly transaction limit for USD purchases; reaching the limit causes payment rejection
local_qualifiers: Argentina: monthly USD transaction limit exists; exceeding it causes payment rejection
parser_notes: support.domestika.org article 360003447297 (undated). Argentina monthly USD transaction cap: limit reached causes rejection of new Domestika purchases.
